rejected_summary.reason: E2 participates in the acidic activation domain; reversal to Arg would likely disrupt recruitment of cyclin T1/P-TEFb.
E9 is in the same acidic cluster; mutation to Arg is incompatible with required activation domain interactions.
D5 is another acidic determinant; neutralizing/reversing its charge is more likely to impair than enhance transactivation.
T20 lies near the cysteine-rich domain boundary; no clear TAR/P-TEFb interaction benefit and possible structural perturbation.
L43 is a buried hydrophobic core residue; an Arg is likely destabilizing and would reduce viability/activity.

reconsideration_rules: reconsider requires trigger_evidence_ids with NEW evidence; without it the action is rejected.
